prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless repeatable surface texture for the solid ceiling tiles of a dark Gothic 2D game HD pack. Create one square, edge-to-edge, opaque, front-facing texture of an ancient slime-coated cavern ceiling. Subdued moss green and deep forest green, muted olive highlights, dark blue-green creases. Bulbous organic wet mineral ridges with thick viscous slime flowing in short vertical rivulets and rounded hanging folds; visibly slimy and organic, not masonry. Medium-dark values, enough restrained highlights to read clearly at tiny pixel-art scale. Rich hand-painted dark fantasy game texture, crisp deliberate forms, no blur or photographic noise. Lighting soft from above. Large coherent shapes that remain readable when reduced to 64x64 pixels. Seamless repeating edges, no perspective, no scene or sky, no text, no grid, no border, no characters. No neon lime or bright emerald, no glowing slime, no square bricks, no gray/brown rock blocks. This is material only; the game will supply the existing ceiling outline.
